headline: Steady top-line growth continues as guidance moves higher
summary_short: Encompass Health's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $1,597M (+9.6% y/y) with net income of $154M (+8.3% y/y, diluted EPS $1.54), while the company raised full-year 2026 revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted EPS guidance and lifted its buyback authorization to $1 billion.
summary_long: Revenue grew 9.6% y/y to $1,597M, driven by discharge growth of 5.6% (2.8% same-store) and a 3.9% rise in net patient revenue per discharge. Adjusted EBITDA rose 9.2% y/y to $348M and adjusted EPS grew 10.7% y/y to $1.55, though both metrics slipped sequentially from Q1, which had included a one-time $17.5M gain on the sale of Gamma Knife assets absent this quarter. Net income was $154M and diluted EPS $1.54. The company raised full-year 2026 guidance for revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted EPS, and increased its common stock repurchase authorization to $1 billion, having already repurchased $145.8M year to date. Cash stood at $108M; shareholders' equity rose to $2,598M.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited 9.6% revenue growth and 9.2% Adjusted EBITDA growth, plus three hospitals (139 beds) opened and 54 beds added at existing facilities, calling the operating strategy validated.
Revenue growth was accompanied by discharges up 5.6% y/y (2.8% same-store) and net patient revenue per discharge up 3.9%, per the release's own growth table.
Sequential (q/q) decline reflects a one-time $17.5M pre-tax gain on sale of Gamma Knife assets recorded in Q1 2026 that the release shows as zero in Q2.
The same Q1-only $17.5M Gamma Knife gain lifted Q1 diluted EPS; its absence in Q2 explains most of the sequential EPS decline.
